features.description: Implement the exact-task-branch cloud start/push protocol, hermetic wrapper-hazard and retry regression tests, unattended no-toolchain and push-per-milestone guidance, byte-identical skill mirrors, Make wiring and changelog fragment.
acceptance_criteria: cloud_branch_sync.sh supports exactly start/push under Bash 3.2 with set -u; every Git call is bounded or naturally finite, network calls are noninteractive, all verdicts name branch/SHA, ordinary outcomes including failed:* return 0, and usage errors alone return 2.

Both commands mutate Git or contact origin only when nonempty AILANG_TASK_ID exactly matches current coordinator/<taskID>; attended, mission, wrong-task, live/direct-push, unset/empty-ID and detached cases skip without changing local state/config or any remote ref. Never force-push or push any other branch.

Both commands idempotently ensure +refs/heads/<branch>:refs/remotes/origin/<branch> before network work while preserving the base fetch entry; successful push leaves the exact remote ref and tracking ref equal to HEAD and verifies equality with ls-remote.

start distinguishes absent rc 2 from lookup errors, prints fresh without changing local work when absent, or fetches and reset --keep resumes the remote task SHA with untracked wrapper files intact; fetch/reset refusal preserves HEAD, index and working files and reports failed:*.

The same faithful Step 5b wrapper simulation after push plus a later local commit detects unpushed work with the helper refspec; the no-refspec shallow-clone control reproduces M2 with log rc 128, ls-remote rc 0, newBranch=false and unpushed=false while remote remains at the earlier commit.

Crash/retry from a fresh --depth 1 --branch file:// clone restores the prior milestone and sprint JSON before milestone selection, keeps an untracked wrapper file, then fast-forward pushes the next commit. Rejected or divergent pushes return failed:* with rc 0 without changing local work or overwriting remote history.

All 22 named arm-to-mutation pairs A01-A22 in the plan have recorded test/mutation evidence, including actual all-remote-ref observations for skipped live branches, config idempotence in both commands, usage, probe/fetch/reset/config failure, verified-SHA mismatch, bounded calls and repeat push.

unattended_runs.md explains start once before milestone selection, read restored JSON and resume first unfinished milestone, commit then push every milestone, the SIGBUS ticket and one-sentence M2 hazard, non-fatal failed verdict recording in JSON notes, and no compiler/sysroot/C/CGO/system-package/Go/z3 installs; missing tools cause recorded focused-test skips left to CI. Preserve already-shipped make test-changed and commit-per-milestone behavior.

Helper, test and resource are byte-identical in .claude and .agents; existing SKILL.md stays unchanged. make/test.mk invokes the test beside test_ci_gate.sh through LAUNCHD_SUITE and syntax-checks both scripts. changelogs/unreleased/2026-10-20-sprint-executor-cloud-push-per-milestone.md exists and opens with ### Changed — Sprint executor cloud milestone durability.

Record focused test_cloud_branch_sync.sh, /bin/bash -n on both scripts, test_agents_skills_sync.sh, make check-changelog and added integration gate make test-launchd-drivers results. Any socket-touching sandbox result is UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX. Never run full make test or install a missing tool; record skipped gates/tools in sprint JSON notes.
